# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2008

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2007. At the close of business on December 31, 2007, there was a savings of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20). The ordinance appropriates funds to cover the overdraft and make expenditures proper and legal for the year 2007.

**Total savings at close of business (Dec 31, 2007):** P 950,005.20
**Total overdraft in appropriation:** P 950,005.20

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** At the close of business on December 31, 2007, there is a savings of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20).
- **Section 2.** The amount of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20) is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Five Pesos and 20/100 (P 950,005.20) to make it proper and legal the expenditures for the year 2007.
- **Section 3.** The Pre-Closing Special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as integral part of this ordinance marked as "Annex A".
